scope: Initiative outbound project email composed or sent by an agent acting for the Product/Code Owner.

rule.description: For initiative outbound email, recipient routing is part of the send decision. Determine To and CC from the concrete project/thread context rather than treating CC as an afterthought.
cc_selection: Include participants whose responsibility, decision authority, execution role, or need for project transparency is materially affected by the message.
Preserve relevant established project stakeholders when the new message continues their subject matter.
Do not inflate CC with people who have no material need to receive the message.
Before adding a new or sensitive recipient whose inclusion is not clearly supported by the project context, obtain human confirmation.
rule.thread_behavior: Reply-all may preserve an existing relevant audience, but initiative messages require an independent recipient review.
rule.evidence: At send time, the selected To/CC set must be explainable from current project context.
